content: Kyakin, atɔŋ in'kyɛɛl, bɛ baar làbye anà kab unsà làbeel a du, làsi an'kyän abe amu Yɛsu awà ntööm anà undweer a angaŋ a làkwikilà ifàkyään bi.
Nde wà lää akà mbuur kun'si, asànaa kàkäl Mɔsɛ, udu a ndwà a Nzam yanswà.
Yàmɛnà naa làkoo a Yɛsu làŋàsöön là Mɔsɛ, asànaa un'tööŋ a ndwà, we anà ibyääl aŋàsöön ndwà ya ŋakwo.
Abun, ndwà yanswà ye anà un'tööŋ aya, kyekà Nzam wà un'tööŋ a indiir byanswà.
Kyekà Mɔsɛ kàkäl un'syääl a lää u ndwà a Nzam yanswà, ntɔn mutà imbäl a indiir kàlàtɛn Nzam ungö.
Wɛɛ Klistɔ wà lää asànaa Mwan, kà un'tswe a ndwà a Nzam. Ndwà ande ya yà bi, isàkal naa bi ban'kaar kam anà làkyän amu nde abyà ifàswaŋ bi ngaal.

content.text: « Ŋàbà, isàkal naa bɛ lan'wem ndaa ande,
twon lan'bäm mpem abɛ asànaa utaaŋ bun'mbäär,
Akun ankaa abɛ ban'leŋ un'swey anà bàkyer an'sii,
itàkal naa ba bàkyàman isal kàkyer mɛ
Kyakin kàwem mɛ nkööl ayin nkyɛl,
waa mɛ kàtɛn naa: "mpem aba yàmubwà ndwaŋ taaŋ lanswà,
ba bàkwen anki muyöb undiir kàdilà mɛ akà ba."
"Kyakin, uboo a nkyɛl amɛ, mɛ kàdi kyän naa:
Ba bàsàbilà anki kà ikal a ngyöör kàlɔ̈n mɛ ntɔn ba!" »

content: Atɔŋ, làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ, wɛy akà umwɛy uboo a bɛ ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akal anà mpem a mbe mpa aye anà làkwikilà ayà ikun'syeenà mutɔn Nzam a mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Wɛɛ, ilä byanswà, làpɛɛl ngwal bɛ a bɛ, itàkal naa taaŋ mbɔɔn ban'kwo mutɛn naa « ŋàbawà », ntɔn akà umwɛy uboo a bɛ man'be màkɔ̈ɔ̈n un'kur musà mpem ande bwoor.
Kyakin bi ibàŋàtüüb a Klistɔ, isàkal naa bi kan'kaar tii u ntsüü, kam alà kun'si bi u nsɛmà.

content.text: « Isàkal naa ŋàbawà bɛ lan'wem ndaa ande,
twon lan'bäm mpem abɛ asànaa bàkyer ataaràbɛ umpal bun'pɛ ba ngö. »

content: Abun, bànà bàmbäär Nzam, ungö bàwem ba ndaa ande? Nkye kà baar banswà kàtwey Mɔsɛ u Ngipiti anki?
Anà bànà nde kàwem nkyɛl mbul an'kwem an'nà? Nkye kà baar bàkyer man'be anki, waa bàkü u nsye ipɔl?
Abun, bànà nde kàdyeel kyän, mutɛn naa: « Ba bàsàbilà anki kà ikäl a ngyöör kàlɔ̈n mɛ ntɔn ba. » Nkye kà akà baar bàtön mukun'kyey anki?
Bi kan'man naa baar abà bàkwe anki mubilà kà ikal a ngyöör ntɔn ba bàkäl anki anà làkwikilà amu Nzam.
